San gachchhadhvan san vadadhvan | Come together, speak together
Hymn 10.191 is the last hymn of the Rigveda. After more than a thousand hymns to fire, storm, soma and dawn, the book's final words ask for something else: come together, speak together, let your minds agree, just as the gods of long ago agreed on their shares. Common the counsel, common the assembly, common the mind. Common your purpose, common your hearts, so that it will go well for you together.
